methodology.candidate_derivation: No SVAR lake candidates were admitted because the derived review subset exists without its governing normalized registry.

temporal_navigation.interpretation_rule: Temporal context summaries support time navigation for the ranked lake set. They remain explicitly separate from direct lake pollen chronology.

neotoma_pollen.temporal_support_note: The compact Neotoma points retain source BP-labelled context without promoting site-level extrema to numeric chronology; admitted sample-owned relational claims govern chronological comparison.
neotoma_pollen.temporal_scope: source-labelled site context with separate sample chronology
neotoma_pollen.distance_scoring_note: Use Neotoma to compare pollen context around lakes; only promote it into chronology-aware support when a numeric interval is actually present.
caveats: Source age-range labels include calendar-comparable BP systems, but the compact site layer withholds numeric intervals because extrema do not establish continuous site coverage.
Some checked-in Neotoma sites remain spatial context only because they do not carry source age-range context.

landclim_pollen.spatial_representation: site-sequence points plus time-window model polygons
landclim_pollen.temporal_support_note: LandClim sequence points carry explicit temporal posture and REVEALS model cells are published as separate, filterable time-window records.
landclim_pollen.temporal_scope: site-sequence coverage and modeled vegetation windows
landclim_pollen.distance_scoring_note: Use LandClim to strengthen pollen context around lakes; do not treat it as direct human or archaeological evidence.
caveats: REVEALS windows are modeled vegetation estimates, not sample-owned chronologies.

sead_archaeology.spatial_representation: site inventory plus record-level chronology points
sead_archaeology.temporal_support_note: The governed SEAD site inventory combines interval-preserving dated context with explicitly untimed spatial context; bulk record-level chronology remains normalized review evidence rather than a separate public GeoJSON.
sead_archaeology.distance_scoring_note: Use SEAD to measure archaeology context around lakes; do not treat it as same-period support unless numeric intervals are explicitly present.
